data.narrative:
Zettascale is a seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Elias Almqvist (CEO) and Prithvi Raj (CTO), with $3M+ raised to date. The Chips & Semiconductors sector includes 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers such as Cerebras, SambaNova Systems, and Etched, though none closely match Zettascale's stage and positioning.

Stage-progression analysis is the only applicable triangulation method. Using $3M in total raised as a proxy for entry valuation and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement yields $7.5M. This method is defensible given Zettascale's stage, though constrained by the private nature of comparable financials. Peer-median analysis could not be applied: while 12 same-sector peers exist, insufficient datapoints (fewer than 3) fell within adjacent stage or similar valuation tier filters. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (median 21.4x across the three public tickers) cannot be deployed absent disclosed revenue from the target.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6M to $9M, with $7.5M–$8M as the median estimate. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue data to benchmark against public comparables, limited visibility into true peer valuations at seed stage within semiconductors, and reliance on a single triangulation method. Additional founder track record and technical differentiation would strengthen conviction, but are outside the scope of quantitative valuation.
